research.title: Geometry & singularities
research.subtitle: Geometric representation meets numerical analysis.
research.description: Isogeometric, generalized finite element, and mapping methods for differential equations in domains with cracks, corners, and boundary layers.
research.scope: Elliptic boundary value problems; cracks and corners; singular perturbations and boundary layers.

research.title: Fractional differential equations
research.subtitle: Numerical algorithms for fractional-order models.
research.description: Efficient methods for fractional initial and boundary value problems, nonlinear time-fractional equations, and fractional dynamical systems.
research.scope: Fractional initial and boundary value problems; nonlinear time-fractional PDEs; fractional dynamical systems.

research.title: Computational mechanics
research.subtitle: Approximation for models of solid deformation.
research.description: Numerical approximation for elasticity and plate models, including problems with cracks, singularities, and fourth-order partial differential equations.
research.scope: Elasticity with cracks or singularities; Reissner–Mindlin plate models; fourth-order partial differential equations.

research_axes.title: Mathematics for AI
research_axes.subtitle: Understanding how learning works.
research_axes.description: Mathematical analysis of deep learning, including weight initialization, signal propagation, and knowledge distillation.
research_axes.scope: Deep neural networks; gradient and signal propagation; model compression.
research_axes.detail: We study the mathematical structure of neural networks and the choices that affect their training and efficiency. Topics include initialization, the propagation of information through deep networks, and the transfer of knowledge between models.

figure.title: Initialization and learning
figure.alt: Two loss-versus-iteration plots comparing initialization settings for PINNs solving the Burgers equation.
figure.caption: PINN training loss for the Burgers equation under different initialization settings.

research_axes.title: AI for Mathematics
research_axes.subtitle: Learning methods for mathematical problems.
research_axes.description: Physics-informed machine learning and deep numerical methods that combine neural networks with differential equations and numerical analysis.
research_axes.scope: Differential equations; inverse problems; learning with physical constraints and observations.
research_axes.detail: We combine learning methods with equations, boundary conditions, and numerical discretization. Topics include physics-informed neural networks, neural methods coupled with isogeometric collocation, and inference from observed data.

figure.title: Neural networks and numerical approximation
figure.alt: Approximate Helmholtz solution plotted on a curved geometry with x and y coordinates.
figure.caption: Helmholtz approximation using isogeometric collocation combined with a neural network.

research_axes.title: Simulation, Analysis & Modeling
research_axes.subtitle: Computing with mathematical and physical models.
research_axes.description: Mathematical models and numerical methods for physical systems, including fluid flow, heat transfer, phase-field models, and fractional dynamics.
research_axes.scope: Partial differential equations; fluid flow and heat transfer; geometric singularities; fractional dynamical systems and optimization.
research_axes.detail: Our numerical work studies how to represent, analyze, and approximate mathematical models. Geometry, physical constraints, and the behavior of the solution guide the construction of computational methods.
